verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for an AI app builder with a hosted backend, so the axis applies. The pack never documents user-schedulable cron jobs or recurring workflows. Edge functions are only a developer building block, and enterprise "scheduled Deep scans" is a vendor-defined security feature rather than a general recurring-job capability, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
